# Visahouse

> Every visa under one roof. Online visa guidance, document checklists, Schengen appointment help, and travel insurance for Pakistani passport holders. Operated by AMG (https://amgvisa.com).

- Brand & Alternate Names: Visahouse, AMG Visa, Visahouse Pakistan
- Website: https://amgvisa.com
- Full Structured Knowledge Base: https://amgvisa.com/llms-full.txt
- WhatsApp / Phone: +92 331 8877655
- Email: info@visahouse.online
- Office Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 – 19:00 PKT
- Disclaimer: Visahouse is a private consultancy, not a government body or embassy. Final decisions rest with the authorities.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://amgvisa.com/): Overview, document checklist builder, visa cost calculator, photo guide, and visa status tracker
- [All Visa Guides](https://amgvisa.com/visas): Directory of 42 country visa guides from Pakistan
- [Schengen Appointments](https://amgvisa.com/schengen-appointments): Official VFS Global & BLS International guidance from Islamabad, Lahore, and Karachi
- [Travel Insurance](https://amgvisa.com/travel-insurance): Schengen-accepted (€30,000+ medical) and worldwide travel insurance plans
- [About Visahouse](https://amgvisa.com/about): How our online visa desk works
- [Contact](https://amgvisa.com/contact): WhatsApp and email inquiry desk
